provenance.rule: Frozen v10 FileSystem checksum bodies on .NET 11, with Crc32.NET pinned exactly as legacy/source/Playnite/Playnite.csproj pins it. Each expectation is the value the frozen source returned; the cross_check column is an independent CPython zlib.crc32/hashlib value for the same bytes, and both must agree. Cases carrying v10_test_constant also reproduce the constant v10's own CheckSumTests asserted.

cross_check.crc32: CPython zlib.crc32 (CRC-32/ISO-HDLC, reflected 0xEDB88320); the standard check value for '123456789' is 0xCBF43926
